interface.Subject: Called by
interface.Content: The front door (119): `run` and `resume` in the foreground for the timeline, `watch` for the card, the inspection commands for the plain form

interface.Subject: Provided by
interface.Content: The presenter (145), with the banner and the theme

interface.Subject: Input
interface.Content: A stream of events: the compatibility projection in compatibility output, the primary event stream in default output (CQ-101); the mode; the detail level; the settings of colour, motion, banner, rail, background and glyphs; the size of the terminal; whether the stream is a terminal

interface.Subject: Output
interface.Content: Lines on the stream the front door names. In compatibility output the lines of the baseline byte for byte. In default output no free text from outside the runtime

interface.Subject: Errors
interface.Content: None that reaches the run. A presenter that fails prints one line and leaves the exit code of the command as it is

interface.Subject: Owner of the four summary lines of the stream
